en-US.description:
IFCDC Barbers makes it easy to book professional barbershop appointments. Browse real haircut and style photos, choose your service, pick a barber and time, and pay securely with PayPal.

Features:
• Book appointments with live availability
• View service photos and style gallery before you book
• Secure PayPal checkout and email confirmations
• AURA assistant for quick booking help
• Manage your profile and booking history

Official app for IFCDC Barbers — smart booking powered by real style photos.
en-US.promoText: Book your next cut — browse styles, pick a barber, pay with PayPal.
en-US.title: IFCDC Barbers
en-US.subtitle: Book cuts with style photos
en-US.releaseNotes:
Version 1.1 (Build 49) — Production release candidate.

• Required phone number on signup for customers, barbers, and shop owners
• Style gallery Like/Unlike with instant count updates
• Discover feed shows all service photos with names and prices
• Profile save and avatar upload improvements
• Admin revenue dashboard accuracy for live PayPal bookings
• Stability and performance improvements across booking, approvals, and portfolio

Customer booking flow (required):
Home → Book → select barber → service → time → PayPal checkout (live payments).

Registration test:
Create Account → choose account type → enter phone (required, 10-digit US format) → complete signup.

Admin (optional):
Sign in with review account if configured as platform admin → Admin tab → Shops / Barbers for approvals.

Account Deletion:
Profile → Delete Account → Type DELETE → Confirm
